description: Use when someone asks how to use a feng shui bagua map in a room or a home, which area of a room is wealth or relationships, or where their door falls on the bagua. It reports what the tradition says; feng shui is a tradition, not a science.

door_position.description: Where the door is on that wall, standing in the doorway looking in: left, middle or right.

door_wall.description: The wall the door is on, as drawn on the plan: bottom, left, top or right.

facing.description: For the compass method: the way you face as you walk in, N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W or NW.

method.description: btb (from the door, the Western school) or compass.

room_length_cm.description: The room’s length, up the plan (cm).

room_width_cm.description: The room’s width, across the plan (cm).
